title: fix: report ledger-rounded realtime billed price
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Uses `handleBalanceDeduction`'s authoritative ledger-rounded `billedPrice` for realtime Tinybird `totalPrice`.
- Keeps `devPrice`, `markupRate`, rate-limit consumption, settlement state, and side-effect ordering unchanged.
- Adds a BYOP rounding regression proving telemetry total equals the actual paid-balance debit.

Checks:
- Biome
- Gen TypeScript typecheck
- Focused regression
- Full realtime test file (39 passed)
- `git diff --check`

gist.headline: The ledger and hive agree
gist.blurb: Realtime usage reports now use the same rounded price the ledger actually debits. Polli has retired the tiny accountant disagreement.
gist.summary: Realtime Tinybird telemetry now records the authoritative ledger-rounded `billedPrice` from `handleBalanceDeduction`, so `totalPrice` exactly matches the balance debit for BYOP requests.
gist.impact: Developers reviewing realtime usage and billing data will see Tinybird `totalPrice` match the amount actually charged after ledger rounding.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny bookkeeper with round glasses comparing a glowing realtime terminal receipt against a garden ledger, with both showing the same neatly rounded total. A helpful CRT monitor robot can hold the matching receipt while small code-plants grow around the accounting desk, representing telemetry and balance settlement staying in sync.
